name: server
description: Backend server for viewing and editing videos.

scripts.compile-go: mkdir -p src/core/bin && go build -o src/core/bin/playlist-parser src/core/go/playlist_parser.go
scripts.build: npm run compile-go && rm -rf dist && tsc
scripts.start: npm run build && systemctl --user start video-server
scripts.restart: npm run build && systemctl --user restart video-server
